goal: Let an account holder protect sign-in with a time-based one-time password, and recover access if they lose the device.

requirements.text: A user can enrol an authenticator app by scanning a QR code, and enrolment is only complete once they confirm one generated code.
When 2FA is enabled, sign-in requires a valid TOTP code after the password step.
A user is issued ten single-use recovery codes at enrolment, and any one of them can replace a TOTP code once.

architecture: Existing Flask app with a session-cookie login. Add a `totp_secret` and `recovery_codes` column to the users table. TOTP verification uses pyotp. No new service.

# PRD: two-factor authentication

## FR-1
A user can enrol an authenticator app by scanning a QR code, and enrolment is only complete once they confirm one generated code.

## FR-2
When 2FA is enabled, sign-in requires a valid TOTP code after the password step.

## FR-3
A user is issued ten single-use recovery codes at enrolment, and any one of them can replace a TOTP code once.
